decisions.decision: Used local oldPlayerId variable, not targetPlayer.playerId, in the new publishes
decisions.rationale: targetPlayer is the same object reference stored in the map and gets mutated to newPlayerId a few lines earlier — using targetPlayer.playerId would silently target the wrong (new) player and produce a false-positive-passing test
